name: cache-store-and-splice
body: Open: the DB splice should seed the next DB from the previous one (preserving unaffected tables/rows) and apply only the delta, then atomically publish; overlay-on-a-fresh-empty-DB is the alternative. The choice must preserve exactness and must be measured on the jgrapht reference workload (where the recorded DB load is ~2s of the ~16s full scan) — netbeans is no longer an acceptance workload. Decide in the plan.
